instruction: Install and configure Squid proxy server
output:
apt install -y squid && echo -e 'http_port 3128
acl localnet src 192.168.1.0/24
http_access allow localnet
cache_dir ufs /var/spool/squid 100 16 256' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid

apt install -y apache2-utils && htpasswd -c /etc/squid/passwords john && echo -e 'auth_param basic program /usr/lib/squid/basic_ncsa_auth /etc/squid/passwords\nacl auth_users proxy_auth REQUIRED\nhttp_access allow auth_users' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid
apt install -y tinyproxy && sed -i 's/Allow 127.0.0.1/Allow 192.168.1.0\/24/' /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf && systemctl restart tinyproxy

apt install -y dante-server && cat > /etc/danted.conf << 'EOF'
internal: 0.0.0.0 port = 1080
external: eth0
socksmethod: username
user.privileged: root
user.unprivileged: nobody
client pass { from: 192.168.1.0/24 to: 0.0.0.0/0 log: error }
socks pass { from: 0.0.0.0/0 to: 0.0.0.0/0 }
EOF && systemctl restart danted
curl -x socks5://user:pass@localhost:1080 https://example.com

apt install -y 3proxy && echo -e 'nserver 8.8.8.8
nscache 65536
proxy -p3128
socks -p1080' > /etc/3proxy/3proxy.cfg && systemctl restart 3proxy

instruction: Set up a transparent proxy with iptables
output: iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 80 -j REDIRECT --to-port 3128

instruction: Use socat to create a generic TCP proxy
output: socat TCP-LISTEN:8080,fork TCP:example.com:80

output: socat OPENSSL-LISTEN:443,cert=server.pem,verify=0,fork TCP:localhost:80

instruction: Tune Nginx worker processes to match CPU cores
output: sed -i 's/worker_processes.*/worker_processes auto;/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload
sed -i 's/worker_connections.*/worker_connections 4096;/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload

instruction: Enable Nginx sendfile for faster static file serving
output: sed -i 's/sendfile off;/sendfile on;/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && echo 'tcp_nopush on;' >> /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload
